nodes.name: Retry Counter - Telegram
nodes.notes: [BUGFIX v0.7.1: original code read Number(item.retry_count ?? 0)+1, but the upstream node's error output does not reliably carry retry_count forward across the retry loop, so the counter reset to 1 every pass and the 3-attempt cap never engaged. Now self-references this node's own previous run via $('Retry Counter - Telegram') so the count survives even when the failing node's error output loses context.]

nodes.name: Get All Leads (Duplicate Check)
nodes.notes: NEW v0.7.0: Reads existing Sheet1 rows so Detect Duplicate can compare emails/phones. VERIFY the 'read' operation dropdown in n8n UI after import (Google Sheets node schema can vary slightly by n8n version).

nodes.name: Detect Duplicate
nodes.notes: NEW v0.7.0: case-insensitive email match (primary) + digits-only phone match (secondary). If 'Get All Leads (Duplicate Check)' returns zero rows (empty sheet), match stays undefined -> is_duplicate=false, so it never blocks the very first lead. [Patched: filters out the alwaysOutputData passthrough item so an empty sheet never self-matches as a duplicate.]

nodes.name: Handle Duplicate Lead
nodes.notes: NEW v0.7.0: does NOT append a new row to Sheet1 (prevents duplicate lead records). No Google Sheets write is wired here on purpose — Hafiz has not created a 'Duplicate Leads' tab yet, and this workflow will not invent a spreadsheet gid. Add a Google Sheets append node here later if a log is wanted.

nodes.name: Notify Duplicate Lead
nodes.notes: NEW v0.7.0: best-effort notification, intentionally NOT wrapped in the retry-loop pattern (duplicate alerts are non-critical, unlike new-lead notifications).

nodes.name: Generate Lead ID
nodes.notes: NEW v0.7.0: ID = LD-YYYYMMDD-XXXX (4-char random base36 suffix). Deliberately NOT a sequential counter read from Sheets — concurrent webhook calls reading 'last row + 1' from Google Sheets is a classic race condition. Random suffix trades strict sequentiality for collision-safety, which is the right trade-off for this scale.

nodes.name: Follow-up Schedule Trigger
nodes.notes: NEW v0.7.0: runs once daily at 09:00 (server/n8n instance timezone). Adjust the cron expression in n8n UI if a different check frequency is wanted.

nodes.name: Filter Due Leads
nodes.notes: NEW v0.7.0: WON/LOST/NEW are excluded by definition (not in FOLLOWUP_STATUSES). Same-day duplicate reminders are blocked via last_reminded_at.

nodes.name: Mark Reminder Sent
nodes.notes: NEW v0.7.0: matches existing row by lead_id and stamps last_reminded_at, so the same lead is not reminded twice in one day. Requires a 'last_reminded_at' column header in Sheet1 (see README changes).

nodes.name: Get All Leads (Find by ID)
nodes.notes: NEW v0.8.0: reads Sheet1 so Find Lead can match the incoming activity's lead_id against the master lead list.

nodes.name: Notify Invalid Activity
nodes.notes: NEW v0.8.0: fires when lead_id on an incoming activity doesn't match any row in Sheet1.

nodes.name: Generate Activity ID
nodes.notes: NEW v0.8.0: ID = ACT-YYYYMMDD-XXXX, same collision-safe pattern as Generate Lead ID. Also flags whether this activity_type should refresh last_contacted_at.

nodes.name: Append Lead Activities
nodes.notes: SETUP REQUIRED (the one manual step): create a new tab named 'Lead Activities' in the 'Automated Business Leads' spreadsheet with header row: activity_id, lead_id, activity_type, channel, description, created_at. Then open this node in n8n and reselect the sheet from the dropdown (the gid placeholder in this JSON cannot be known before the tab exists).

nodes.name: Update Last Contacted
nodes.notes: NEW v0.8.0: matches Sheet1 row by lead_id and stamps last_contacted_at whenever a contact-type activity (CONTACTED, REPLIED, CALL, MEETING, PROPOSAL_SENT, FOLLOW_UP) is logged.

nodes.name: Lead Intelligence Schedule Trigger
nodes.notes: NEW v0.8.0: runs daily at 08:00 (n8n instance timezone), one hour before Follow-up Schedule Trigger. Adjust cron in n8n UI if a different time is wanted.

nodes.name: Calculate Lead Intelligence
nodes.notes: NEW v0.8.0: computes pipeline value (NEW/CONTACTED/QUALIFIED/PROPOSAL budgets), overdue count (next_follow_up_at passed), at-risk/stale counts (0-3d ACTIVE, 4-7d AT_RISK, 8+d STALE based on last_contacted_at), and conversion rates (Lead->Won, Qualified->Won, Proposal->Won).
